components.responsibility: Android OS-protected storage of the opaque same-user MIRA client credential using Android Keystore and authenticated no-backup ciphertext.
components.why_separate: Native credential protection is a client security boundary below transport and UI; it must not absorb provider credentials, canonical state, offline synchronization, or server-side revocation authority.

components.responsibility: Android replay-safe encrypted local state for exact provider-neutral API command intents, acknowledgement replay suppression, nonauthoritative canonical snapshots, and opaque reconnect cursor compare-and-set state.
components.why_separate: Local offline persistence is a client synchronization primitive below transport and UI. It stages exact API intent and verified-readback cache material without becoming network transport, conflict policy, provider authority, or canonical state.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral Android reconnect orchestration enforcing exact queued-command replay, verified terminal acknowledgement, verified canonical snapshot persistence, and snapshot-before-cursor progression.
components.why_separate: Reconnect orchestration coordinates durable local state with future authenticated transports without owning provider OAuth, network implementation, canonical authority, conflict UI, or provider connection UX.

components.responsibility: Default-Personal Android mapping between exact API command intent / reconnect change pages and the MIRA Google Workspace Commands and verified Changes row protocols through an injected authorized Sheets gateway.
components.why_separate: The row protocol must validate provider transport evidence without owning OAuth UI, account selection, spreadsheet discovery, provider identifiers, network client lifecycle, canonical authority, or local persistence.

components.responsibility: Least-privilege Google Identity Services authorization for the Android Personal Workspace lane using drive.file and provider-owned single-Sheet Picker selection, with fail-closed ephemeral grant validation.
components.why_separate: Google authorization and unavoidable provider UI are provider-specific capability concerns; access tokens and selected provider resource identifiers must not enter provider-neutral core, canonical state, or offline persistence.

components.responsibility: Bounded HTTPS Google Sheets values read and Commands-only RAW append gateway beneath the default-Personal Workspace row transport, with no internal ambiguous-write retry.
components.why_separate: Concrete Google network behavior and bearer-token handling are provider-specific and must remain below the provider-neutral row protocol while preventing direct canonical Resource/Changes mutation.

components.responsibility: Read-only post-consent verification of exact MIRA Personal Workspace Metadata plus Commands/Changes protocol before constructing a usable GoogleWorkspaceTransport binding.
components.why_separate: Provider authorization proves file access, not MIRA readiness. Binding must independently verify the selected resource without writes and without weakening the canonical authority or transport contracts.
